  CONGRATULATIONS!

  On the special occasion of your 100th birthday, the City Council extends our sincere
  congratulations and we wish you continued good health and much happiness with
  friends and family. For your volunteer service to community, we extend our gratitude.

  ANH TIEU DANG

  (Presented by Mayor Chan)

  CONGRATULATIONS!
  On the special occasion of your 97th birthday, the City Council extends our sincere
  congratulations and we wish you continued good health and much happiness with
  friends and family.

  ALICIA OCHOA

  (Presented by Mayor Chan)

  IN RECOGNITION!

  AMERICAN RED CROSS MONTH RESOLUTION
  For responding to, and helping people recover from record-breaking disasters
  throughout the year that impact people across the United States, the Monterey Park
City Council recognizes the month of March as American Red Cross Month and extends
  our gratitude to the volunteers who reach out to help people in need.

  (Presented by Mayor Chan)
   CONGRATULATIONS!
  To the Mark Keppel High School Future Business Leaders of America (FBLA) for
  winning the Sweepstakes Award at the February 9, 2019 FBLA America Gold Coast
Conference, where over 600 students from approximately 25 schools competed, and 28
students qualified to compete at the April 25-28 FBLA State Conference in Sacramento,
  the City Council applauds your accomplishments.
